messages:
kelly_cs: Opening SummitLabs week0 thread. Blockers: KMS BYOK approval pending (ticket SL-4041), outbound egress to partner ranges blocked, and no events showing in their HEC endpoint. Need infra/security/ops owners.

omar_infra: I can handle the egress once I have exact CIDR+ports and which private subnets to scope. Also confirm if traffic should go via NAT GW or a VPC endpoint.

kelly_cs: Partner endpoints: 23.45.67.0/24 port 443 for API, 23.45.68.16/28 port 8088 for Splunk HEC. Use NAT GW ngw-90b, subnets summit-private-a/b. Ticket SL-4041 has BYOK details.

nate_security: BYOK attestation required (HSM provenance + fingerprint). Drafting minimal key policy to restrict use to the redwood runtime role and deny console decrypts and iam:PassRole for user principals. Will post to SL-4041. Note: BYOK may add ~48h compliance review.

yara_ops: Quick Splunk HEC connectivity test (replace <TOKEN>):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://splunk.summitlabs.io:8088/services/collector/event -H "Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>" -d '{"event":"summit test"}'
```

204 = success. Common failures: token missing/invalid, TLS issues, or egress blocked. Also check VPC Flow Logs in s3://summit-logs/flow/ for recent PutObject activity.

deploy_bot: priv-deploy/summitlabs v0.2.0 smoke started at 3301234580. status: partial-success. failed-tests: audit-forwarding,kms-policy

omar_infra: I created change request cr-330 to add egress from summit-private-* -> 23.45.67.0/24:443 and 23.45.68.16/28:8088 via ngw-90b. ETA ~5m to propagate.

kelly_cs: Asked customer to rotate HEC token for quick test and to upload BYOK attestation PDF + key ARN. AM note: customer mentioned onboarding speed on renewal call. If BYOK + audit ingestion not confirmed within 72h escalate to AM/Finance and mark renewal at-risk.

nate_security: Posted key policy draft to SL-4041 that includes explicit kms:ViaService and a condition limiting calls to our runtime VPC. Tagging @omar_infra for any infra constraints.

yara_ops: After CR is active I'll run the curl test and tail forwarder logs. I'll paste results here.

omar_infra: CR cr-330 applied. please retry in ~2m.

yara_ops: Ran curl at 3301234605 -> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized. Forwarder log: "invalid token". Pasting snippet to SL-4041.

kelly_cs: Customer rotated token and uploaded attestation PDF and key ARN (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222:key/zz11-yy22). Pinging @nate_security for final policy review.

nate_security: Reviewing attestation now. If everything checks out I'll add the KMS ARN condition to the bucket policy sample and sign-off. Compliance review may still add ~24h.

yara_ops: Re-ran curl at 3301234609 -> 204 No Content. Forwarder logs show events accepted. Uploading artifacts to SL-4041. Will monitor delivery for 24h and drop evidence.

am_monica: Flagging renewal board: monitor for sustained delivery 24-48h. If instability persists past 72h we'll trigger renewal outreach.

kelly_cs: Action items: @nate_security finish attestation review and close SL-4041; @omar_infra attach cr-330 and confirm persisted; @yara_ops monitor Splunk for 24h and upload logs; @am_monica track renewal board. Week1 follow-up scheduled 3301310400. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
